answer: Spatial Beacon Ledger: each agent identity must periodically submit a signed location proof witnessed by any three neighbors within signal range, hashed into a shared ledger. An identity sitting on the same crystal-verified ridge as others cannot fake distance. Attackers must physically deploy hardware across separate zones, because a single operator mass-registering identities from one lagoon site collapses into one witness cluster. The per-identity cost is a distinct radio footprint plus continuous presence, not money.
